record.context_brief: Coset structures for skew Heyting and skew Boolean algebras
record.original_question: Build on the coset structure of skew distributive lattices to characterize skew Heyting algebras through coset structure. Also determine the coset structure of skew Boolean algebras and whether that structure gives insight into the corresponding dual spaces.

evidence.quote: Can we build on the coset structure of a skew distributive lattice to characterize skew Heyting algebras through their coset structure.
Will it give us some insights on the respective dual spaces?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A skew lattice is an algebra $(S;\wedge,\vee)$ where $\wedge$ and $\vee$ are associative, idempotent binary operations satisfying the absorption identities $x\wedge(x\vee y)=x=(y\vee x)\wedge x$ and $x\vee(x\wedge y)=x=(y\wedge x)\vee x$. A skew lattice is distributive if it satisfies $x\wedge(y\vee z)\wedge x=(x\wedge y\wedge x)\vee(x\wedge z\wedge x)$ and $x\vee(y\wedge z)\vee x=(x\vee y\vee x)\wedge(x\vee z\vee x)$. Green's equivalence $\mathcal D$ on a skew lattice is a congruence whose classes are maximal rectangular subalgebras; for $\mathcal D$-classes $A\le B$ (with $A$ below $B$ in the induced lattice $S/\mathcal D$), the cosets of $A$ in $B$ are the subsets $A\vee b\vee A=\{a\vee b\vee a':a,a'\in A\}$ for $b\in B$, and they partition $B$. Together with the dually defined cosets of $B$ in $A$ and the coset bijections between them, this collection forms the coset structure of $S$.

A skew Heyting algebra is a skew lattice with top, equipped with a binary operation $\to$ such that for each $u$ in the algebra, the principal subalgebra $u^\wedge S\,u^\wedge:=\{u\wedge x\wedge u:x\in S\}$ (with the induced operations and with $u$ as top) is a Heyting algebra whose implication is the restriction of $\to$. A skew Boolean algebra is a skew lattice with zero in which every principal subalgebra $u^\wedge S\,u^\wedge$ is a generalized Boolean algebra.

Problem. (a) Using the coset structure of distributive skew lattices, give a characterization of skew Heyting algebras in terms of their coset structure (i.e., describe internally those coset systems that arise from skew Heyting algebras, including how the implication $\to$ is encoded by the coset data).
(b) Determine the coset structure of skew Boolean algebras explicitly.
(c) Decide whether the coset descriptions obtained in (a) and (b) yield new information about the corresponding dual spaces (in particular the étale/sheaf-theoretic dual spaces of skew Boolean algebras and the Esakia-type duals of skew Heyting algebras).
artifact.status_search_result: A 2022 talk by Pita Costa is titled "The coset structure of skew Boolean algebras," indicating ongoing investigation of part (b), and there are recent papers on the coset structure of distributive skew lattices and on skew Heyting algebras. However, no published source explicitly carries out the full coset-theoretic characterization of skew Heyting algebras together with the dual-space consequences requested. The problem appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Joao Pita Costa: The coset structure of skew Boolean algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Talk titled 'The coset structure of skew Boolean algebras' (2022), indicating the question is still being actively explored.
status_evidence.claim: Coset structure of skew Boolean algebras remains a topic of ongoing research.

status_evidence.title: On the coset structure of distributive skew lattices
status_evidence.snippet: Recent paper developing the coset structure of distributive skew lattices, a prerequisite for the asked-for characterization.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational results exist but the extension to skew Heyting algebras is not yet completed.

status_evidence.title: On skew Heyting algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Defines skew Heyting algebras and studies their basic properties without addressing a coset-structure characterization.
status_evidence.claim: Skew Heyting algebras are studied without the coset characterization requested.
